throttle_rationale.PlayRain: No per-call throttle. Rain is a looping bed (not a one-shot). Idempotency is provided by the isPlaying+clip guard inside PlayRain() and the _lastKind state machine in RainSoundDriver — calling PlayRain() while rain loops is a no-op. Pattern is correct per Sound Designer role: looping beds never need a time-throttle, only idempotent start/stop.
throttle_rationale.StopRain: No throttle. Unity's AudioSource.Stop() is idempotent when not playing.
